description: Declare which version of ANOTHER DESIGN this one depends on — the pin a seam analysis is taken AS OF. Records the source, the version (a tag or commit), the parts taken, and the build switches forwarded BY NAME, because a renamed feature is a downstream build break that no API diff or surface export would mention. This is what you MEAN to depend on; reconcile_dependencies compares it against what the build actually resolves. A declaration without a version is refused: the version is the whole point.

components.description: The parts actually taken — crate names, service names.

declared_in.description: Which build file the pin actually lives in.

features.description:
Build switches forwarded to the dependency BY NAME. A renamed feature is
a build break no API diff would mention, so it belongs in the record.

source.description: Where it comes from — a git URL, a registry, a path.

version.description: The version this design MEANS to depend on: a tag, a commit, a release.

name: declare_dependency
